extDescFull.message: Voice-to-text in any language with history, healing and settings. Powered by local Whisper AI.

extDescLite.message: Quick voice-to-text in any language: record, transcribe, copy. Powered by local Whisper AI.

insertTitle.message: Type the transcript into the focused text field on the current page

modelFirstDownloadHint.message: First-time model downloads from HuggingFace can take a few minutes. The model is cached after this.

micBlockedLite.message: Microphone access was blocked. Chrome doesn't show permission prompts in extension popups.

openInTab.message: Open in full tab to grant mic access

nudgeMultilingual.message: Your browser is set to $1, but the current model only understands English. Switch to $2?

nudgeGpu.message: Your device has GPU acceleration — the $1 model is noticeably more accurate and still fast here.

noApiKey.message: No API key configured. Go to Settings to add one.

rateLimited.message: Rate limit reached. The shared key has limited usage. Add your own free Gemini API key in Settings for unlimited access.

languageAutoHint.message: Auto-detect reads the language from the first seconds of each recording, then keeps it for the rest of it.

modelEnglishOnlyHint.message: The selected model is English-only; other languages won't be recognized.

modelChangeHint.message: Changing model triggers a one-time download on first use, then caches locally.

modelNoteBaseEn.message: More accurate; comfortable with GPU acceleration.

modelNoteSmallEn.message: Best English accuracy. Needs GPU acceleration.

modelNoteBaseMulti.message: 99 languages. Default when the browser isn't in English.

modelNoteSmallMulti.message: Much better for Spanish, Chinese, Portuguese… Needs GPU acceleration.

insertHint.message: Type the transcript into the focused text field automatically (also copied)

structuringHint.message: Restructure transcripts into clean prompts using an AI provider.

providerPaidWarning.message: This provider charges per API call. Costs are billed by $1 to your account. Check their pricing page for current rates.

sharedKeyHint.message: Free, shared across all users. Rate limited — may be slow during peak usage.

ownKeyHint.message: Get a free key at aistudio.google.com. Higher limits, no sharing.

ownKeyModelsHint.message: Use your own key to access all available models.

smartCorrectionHint.message: After each recording, fix misheard words from sentence context. Sends the transcript text to the provider above (Gemini shared key by default).
